info.name: Dual Music API
info.description: REST API collection for the Dual Music backend (Node/Express/Sequelize/MySQL). Set the `baseUrl` variable (default http://localhost:4000/api/v1). Register or Login auto-saves `accessToken` and `refreshToken` via test scripts. All non-public requests inherit Bearer auth from the collection.
